purpose: Reconcile the reproducible Ryo/Ryo source cut with the runtime schema in the current project tree; this is a study result, not promotion.

inputs.reproduction_command: PYTHONPATH=tools/sms_wrapper python3 -m mugen2sms versus-cut --p1-source base/OUTROS/ffspRyo_v3.zip --p1-config data/ryo_v3_runtime_cut_20261006.json --p2-source base/OUTROS/ffspRyo_v3.zip --p2-config data/ryo_v3_runtime_cut_20261006.json --out <temporary-output>

source_route_dispatch_contract.scope: pattern-to-source target binding only; source controller predicates and gameplay effects are not executed by these tables

generation_comparison.runtime_delta: Generated v5 adds a 13-route source binding table per slot, updates CMD patterns to v4 encoding, and records the dispatch contract. The source-route table binds pattern to source state/action/animation; it does not execute controller predicates or gameplay effects.

compile_attempt.scope: temporary copy under /run/user/1000/codex-desktop/ryo_ryo_build_20261008; project source tree was not changed
compile_attempt.result: FAILED during src/fight.c compile; no ROM was produced
compile_attempt.first_error: Initial unmodified copy: generated fight_runtime_data.h uses AT_N but canonical src/fight.c does not define it; its CharacterData declaration also lacks close_distances_q8, far_distances_q8, and ground_front_q8. After adding only those declarations in a temporary probe, compilation/linking succeeded with 20 generated state rows overflowing 12 runtime slots, then makesms failed with Bank 1 overflow; no ROM was produced.

nearby_study_implementation.reason: uses an expanded state model and a different banked runtime contract; not a file-level substitute for canonical fight.c

runtime_compatibility.interpretation: Do not fix this by adding AT_N and fields alone. State indices/count, route consumption, and banked metadata layout need one explicit runtime contract.

compatibility_probe.scope: second build attempt in the same temporary project after a local-only struct patch; original project src/fight.c was not modified
compatibility_probe.changes: added enum AT_LP/AT_HP/AT_LK/AT_HK/AT_N and three CharacterData fields: close_distances_q8, far_distances_q8, ground_front_q8
compatibility_probe.compile_and_link: completed for all seven C modules and linked an 88,044-byte IHX
warnings: generated p1_states and p2_states each provide 20 StateDef rows, while the current fight.c ST_N_STATES is 12; SDCC reports excess initializer elements, so the generated far-state rows are truncated from those arrays
compatibility_probe.makesms: FAILED: Fatal: Bank 1 overflow while merging the 38-bank image bundle at destination bank 2
compatibility_probe.conclusion: The minimal struct patch is insufficient. The generated state-table shape and banked metadata layout also require a matching runtime integration; route tables remain unconsumed by the current C code.

focused_validation.runtime_probe: Second temporary build compiled and linked but emitted state-array truncation warnings; makesms failed Bank 1 overflow; no ROM.

native_qa.reason: Canonical doc/10-memory-bank.md and companion authority docs previously returned EIO; SMS_GLOBAL §99 prohibits substituting historical snapshots or preparing QA with unreadable authority context. No ROM or native worker was produced in this step.

next_safe_actions: After current authority documents are readable, choose the supported runtime schema and reconcile the Ryo/Ryo package against its state model instead of mixing generated headers with the old FSM.
Add explicit C runtime consumption for source-route tables only with a bounded semantics contract; keep predicates/effects marked unsupported until implemented.
Build the complete candidate, then run private native QA on that exact ROM before promotion.
disposition: The direct versus-cut v5 output does not build against canonical fight.c. A separate banked schema-v6 pipeline using the Ryo/Ryo cut and the advanced study runtime built a 720,896-byte candidate ROM with pre-gates passing and exact bank bytes in the ROM. It remains a study candidate: source-route behavior is not executed, the asset-binding map is absent, and there is no emulator evidence.

banked_runtime_probe.emulator_qa: not performed; §99 blocks QA context while canonical docs return EIO
banked_runtime_probe.classification: separate schema-v6 banked runtime study candidate; not a canonical-source build and not promoted
